dataset_metadata.name: CALCE CS2 Pouch Cell Aging Dataset
dataset_metadata.citation: [1] He W., Williard N., Osterman M., Pecht M., 'Prognostics of lithium-ion batteries based on Dempster–Shafer theory and the Bayesian Monte Carlo method,' Journal of Power Sources, 196(23), pp.10314-10321, 2011. [2] Xing Y., Ma E., Tsui K.L., Pecht M., 'An Ensemble Model for Predicting the Remaining Useful Performance of Lithium-ion Batteries,' Microelectronics Reliability, 53(6), pp.811-820, 2013. [3] Williard N., He W., Osterman M., Pecht M., 'Comparative Analysis of Features for Determining State of Health in Lithium-Ion Batteries,' International Journal of Prognostics and Health Management, 4, pp.1-7, 2013.

cell_info.cell_notes: LiCoO2 cathode; EDS results also showed trace elements of Manganese. Jellyroll configuration wrapped around the 'length' axis. Weight reported without safety circuit. Anode assumed graphite (not stated in CALCE documentation).

aging_modes.notes: 6 condition types: Type 1 – full cycling at 0.5C discharge (CS2-8, 21, 33, 34); Type 2 – full cycling at 1C discharge (CS2-35, 36, 37, 38); Type 3 – variable discharge current alternating between 0.1C, 0.2C, 0.5C, 1C, 1.5C, 2C each cycle (CS2-3, 9); Type 4 – 0.5C discharge with randomly varying cutoff voltage (CS2-7); Type 5 – partial low-range cycling between 2.7V and 3.77V at 0.5C (CS2-5, 6), each file begins with a full reference cycle at 0.2C; Type 6 – partial high-range cycling between 3.77V and 4.2V at 0.5C (CS2-24, 25), each file begins with a full reference cycle at 0.2C. Charge protocol is identical for all cells. Cells CS2-8 and CS2-21 tested with CADEX tester (data in .txt); all others with Arbin tester (data in Excel). No EOL threshold explicitly stated (only in photo).

time_protocol.test_equipment: Arbin Battery Tester (most cells); CADEX Battery Tester (CS2-8, CS2-21)

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Data files for each cell consist of multiple Excel files named by testing date (Arbin tester). CS2-8 and CS2-21 data files are in .txt format (CADEX tester).

checkup.notes: No dedicated periodic check-up protocol described. Types 5 and 6 include a full charge/discharge reference cycle at the start of each data file, but this is not a separate periodic RPT in the traditional sense.

notes: Dataset published by the CALCE battery group at the University of Maryland. No testing temperature is reported anywhere in the source documents. The CV cutoff current of 0.05A corresponds to approximately 0.045C given the 1.1 Ah nominal capacity. Discharge C-rates for Type 3 are inferred from the stated absolute currents (0.11, 0.22, 0.55, 1.1, 1.65, 2.2 A) divided by the 1.1 Ah nominal capacity. Type 4 introduces a stochastic cutoff voltage, classified as cycling_variable. The manufacturer of the CS2 cell is not identified in the source documents.
